name: u8to64_le
declaration: unsafe fn u8to64_le (buf : & [u8] , start : usize , len : usize) -> u64
documentation:
Loads a u64 using up to 7 bytes of a byte slice. It looks clumsy but the
 `copy_nonoverlapping` calls that occur (via `load_int_le!`) all have fixed
 sizes and avoid calling `memcpy`, which is good for speed.

 Safety: this performs unchecked indexing of `buf` at `start..start+len`, so
 that must be in-bounds.
rules: For safety, the range `start..start+len` must be in bounds of `buf`, because `u8to64_le` performs unchecked indexing over that range.
